## Commit subject prefix

The changelog is generated from commit subjects. Use a prefix so the entry lands in the right
section, or leave it off and it will be filed under Improvement:

`feat:` new  ·  `fix:` fix  ·  `perf:` / `refactor:` / `build:` improvement  ·  `docs:` / `chore:`
/ `test:` / `ci:` left out  ·  add `!` before the colon for a breaking change.
